summary.para: Summarise the DEM in a band along a line drawn across a scarp (lowest, quartiles, median and highest heights every 15 m), and estimate the scarp's height from the far-field surfaces either side.

usage.bullet_item: Draw the line across the scarp, from the upthrown to the downthrown side or the reverse; distances are measured from its first point.

For the scarp height, give a distance range on each side, away from the scarp face. Straight lines are fitted to the median there; their separation at the scarp's middle is reported with a 1-sigma uncertainty (a lower bound).
Only the DEM around the line is read. Works on GEM-15 mosaic datasets, VRTs and clips in a projected (metre) coordinate system.
Features narrower than about 45 m (3 pixels) or lower than 1-2 m are beyond what 15 m, machine-learning elevation supports.
